author: Ari Koslow
title: Cameron Carr selected No. 24 overall by Knicks, traded to Lakers
desc: Cameron Carr has been selected No. 24 overall by the Knicks in the 2026 NBA Draft.  He will be traded to the Lakers.
impact: Carr averaged just under 19 points in his one season at Baylor last year. He should add more athleticism and shooting to a Lakers team looking to bring back LeBron James in free agency.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Zuby Ejiofor selected No. 23 overall by Hawks
desc: Zuby Ejiofor has been selected No. 23 overall by the Hawks in the 2026 NBA Draft
impact: Ejiofor will add more size and physicality down low for Atlanta. He was one of the top rim protectors in college basketball and is also an underrated passer for a player of his size.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Labaron Philon selected No. 22 overall by 76ers
desc: Labaron Philon has been selected No. 22 overall by the 76ers in the 2026 NBA Draft.
impact: Philon fell quite a bit in the draft compared to where he was projected to go in most mock drafts. He'll make an immediate impact for a 76ers team built to win and compete now around Joel Embiid. He'll add even more athleticism to the back court with Tyrese Maxey and VJ Edgecombe.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Karim Lopez selected No. 21 by Pistons, traded to Grizzlies
desc: Karim Lopez has been selected No. 21 overall by the Pistons in the 2026 NBA Draft. He will be traded to the Grizzlies.
impact: Lopez spent the past two years in the NBL and was the first international prospect off the board. He projects as a tough and physical forward who will look to work to improve his perimeter shooting.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jayden Quaintance selected No. 20 overall by Spurs
desc: Jayden Quaintance has been selected No.18 overall by the Spurs in the 2026 NBA Draft.
impact: Quaintance appeared in just four games at Kentucky last season after transferring from Arizona State where he tore his ACL. He is a project who will get to sit and develop as part of a deep and young Spurs rotation.

author: Garrett Ball
title: Allen Graves selected No.19 overall by Raptors
desc: Allen Graves has been selected No.19 overall by the Toronto Raptors in the 2026 NBA Draft.
impact: Graves should find himself having a nice role for the Raptors as they look to bolster their team for another playoff run. He's the analytics darling of the draft out of the small school of Santa Clara, and his passing and shooting skills will be valuable moving forward.

author: Garrett Ball
title: Christian Anderson selected No.18 by Hornets
desc: Christian Anderson has been selected No.18 overall by the Hornets in the 2026 NBA Draft.
impact: Anderson joins an increasingly lethal group of guards in Charlotte with LaMelo Ball, Coby White, and Kon Knueppel. Anderson is a top-tier shooter and will live on the outside.

author: Garrett Ball
title: Ebuka Okorie selected No.17 overall by Thunder
desc: Ebuka Okorie has been selected No.17 overall by the Oklahoma City Thunder in the 2026 NBA Draft. That pick was traded to the Grizzlies as the Thunder traded up to 16, and Memphis, in turn, traded the 17th pick to Detroit.
impact: After some shuffling, Okorie is going to land in Detroit and join Cade Cunningham. He fits the Pistons' defensive style, but might struggle at times due to his smaller size.

author: Garrett Ball
title: Bennett Stirtz selected No.16 overall by Grizzlies
desc: Bennett Stritz has been selected No.16 overall by the Memphis Grizzlies in the 2026 NBA Draft. He was then traded to the OKC Thunder for the No.17 pick and two second-round picks.
impact: Stirtz was a high usage player in college and showed plenty of ability to carry the load on offense. He could be a big part of the Thunder's bench unit as they look to retool and stay under the cap while still being competitive.

author: Garrett Ball
title: Hannes Steinbach selected No.14 overall by Hornets
desc: Hannes Steinbach has been selected No.14 overall in the 2026 NBA Draft by the Charlotte Hornets.
impact: Steinbach should give the Hornets plenty of rebounding prowess, as he averaged nearly 12 rebounds a game in the 2025-26 season for the Washington Huskies. With the Hornets' need for a backup option at center/forward, Steinbach, who tries his best to emulate Dirk's one-foot stepback jumper, should slide in nicely.

author: Garrett Ball
title: Dailyn Swain selected No.15 overall by Bulls
desc: Dailyn Swain has been selected No.15 overall by the Chicago Bulls in the 2026 NBA Draft.
impact: Swain will join Chicago's plethora of guard talent and look to give them some good floor spacing and two-way play. He led the Longhorns to a surprise Sweet-16 run in the 2025-26 NCAA Tournament as an 11-seed, and will look to help get Chicago back into the playoffs.

author: Garrett Ball
title: Nate Ament selected No.13 overall by the Heat
desc: Nate Ament has been selected No.13 overall by the Miami Heat in the 2026 NBA Draft. He will be moved to the Bucks as part of the Giannis trade.
impact: The Bucks chose Ament with the pick they received from the Giannis Antetokounmpo trade, and funny enough, Ament is also a forward. Ament has size and potential for days, but he struggled a bit and slid down draft boards after having some inconsistencies during his college season at Tennessee. But with the Bucks in a rebuilding phase, he will have the opportunity to grow and learn.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Aday Mara selected 12th overall by Thunder
desc: Aday Mara has been selected with the No. 12 overall pick by the Oklahoma City Thunder in the 2026 NBA Draft.

author: Garrett Ball
title: Yaxel Lendeborg selected No.11 overall by Warriors
desc: Yaxel Lendeborg was selected No.11 overall by the Golden State Warriors in the 2026 NBA Draft.
impact: In an age dominated by young one-and-dones, Lendeborg is a 23-year-old senior coming in to play for a win-now Warriors team. He has more experience than most other players in this draft, something the veteran-dominant Warriors will appreciate. He will likely play a bench role for the team in his first year.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Brayden Burries selected tenth overall by Bucks
desc: Brayden Burries has been selected with the No. 10 overall pick by the Milwaukee Bucks in the 2026 NBA Draft.
